To add more bins, Copypaste the following plugins:

-Bin number
-Get typed array
-Bin output

Then connect the fft-bins output from Analyse into the array of your new copypaste. Then change the bin number to something else.

Sequencer  is the system that
changes the scene 
in synch with the music.

I wrote down the synch points on paper in seconds, and the sequencer changes  the scene number on those 
points.
Above are the ten scenes that make up this demo. Click on the pencil icon to see what's in them.
You can connect this "scene number" patch into the number slot of the Scene changer revolver to view an individual scene, instead of the whole sequenced piece.
